I first discovered [Cult Repo][1] through the [Node JS][2] and [Python][3] documentaries back in 2024 and 2025. What I didn't know, was that they have been creating software related documentaries (Kubernetes, Prometheus, Ruby, etc.) since 2018. Their most recent movies are about [C++][4] and Java's [Spring Boot Framework][5]. And although I never was a C++, nor Java developer, I really enjoyed both movies.
